_doc: Critical legacy/consolidated URLs that must ALWAYS 301 in a single hop to a live page. A vanished qppr rule turns one of these into a 404 silently; check_redirect_sentinels.py catches that before users do. When you trash/consolidate a high-value page and add its 301 to Quick Redirects, add a sentinel here too. host = staging base used for verification.
